acceptedCheckpointRequires: All assigned peer and runtime constraints are satisfied from a clean deterministic install.
Forward and reverse build, browser, failure-path, and wave-specific evidence passes.
No exact lock, exception, migration, Git action, paid or external write, production promotion, or deployment proceeds without its separate unsatisfied gate.
checkpointPolicy.forbiddenCheckpoint: React 19 with React Three Fiber 8 or Drei 9 is never an acceptable checkpoint.
checkpointPolicy.currentState: No checkpoint in this model is accepted or implementation-authorized.

waves.name: Trustworthy baseline stabilization
waves.scope: Fix only the known hook-order, admin-authorization, and PostgreSQL-configuration defects under the later approved Phase 2 contract.
requiredTests: Failing regression and negative tests first
waves.rollback: Restore the bounded source patch while retaining the regression evidence; no dependency change is part of this wave.

waves.name: Node and npm runtime pair
waves.scope: Move Node and npm as one runtime pair; spike npm 12 first and keep bundled npm only as an exception path.
waves.rollback: Restore the prior Node/npm pair, runtime descriptor, and both exact package locks.

waves.name: Vite and React plugin
waves.scope: Move Vite and its React plugin as one toolchain pair after the runtime pair is proven.
waves.rollback: Restore the prior Vite/plugin pair, configuration, and exact lock.

waves.name: TypeScript and ESLint toolchain
waves.scope: Spike the TypeScript 7 compiler plus TypeScript 6 API bridge and the TypeScript 6-only exception; move ESLint, parser, plugin, and hook rules only as a proven set.
waves.rollback: Restore the prior compiler, ESLint, parser/plugins, configuration, and exact lock as one set.

waves.name: Atomic React and React Three integration
waves.scope: React, React DOM, both React type packages, React Three Fiber, and Drei transition atomically. Three 0.160.1 may be retained only because the recorded candidate peer floors include it and the same spike proves behavior.
requiredTests: Asset, interaction, screenshot, memory, performance, reduced-motion, and Quick Access evidence
waves.rollback: Restore React 18.3.1, React DOM 18.3.1, React types 18, R3F 8.18.0, Drei 9.122.0, and the prior exact lock together.

waves.name: React Router topology
waves.scope: Migrate the Router package and import topology only after CP-04. CP-04 may retain react-router-dom 6.30.3 only when same-day peer and route evidence proves it with the accepted React set; otherwise this change joins WAVE-04 before CP-04 can pass.
waves.rollback: Restore the prior Router package, imports, route behavior, and exact lock without changing the accepted React/R3F/Drei set.

waves.name: Three renderer core
waves.scope: Move Three separately only after CP-04 proves the retained Three 0.160.1 satisfies every selected R3F/Drei peer and behavior contract.
waves.rollback: Restore the retained proven Three version and exact lock while keeping the accepted React/R3F/Drei generation.

waves.name: Zustand state layer
waves.scope: Move Zustand alone after the React/3D checkpoint so selector and scene-consumer changes remain reversible.
waves.rollback: Restore the prior Zustand package and state integration.

waves.name: GSAP motion layer
waves.scope: Move GSAP alone without UI redesign or other motion changes.
waves.rollback: Restore the prior GSAP package and animation integration.

waves.name: Tailwind and PostCSS integration
waves.scope: Move Tailwind and the selected PostCSS topology after approved production UI references; do not combine with design changes.
requiredTests: Responsive, focus, contrast, and visual baselines
waves.rollback: Restore the prior Tailwind/PostCSS/Autoprefixer configuration and exact lock.

waves.name: Python backend and deterministic lock
waves.scope: Move the Python patch, FastAPI stack, data libraries, auth libraries, pytest plugins, and approved deterministic lock without schema change.
requiredTests: Two identical clean locked syncs with hashes
Lifespan, WebSocket, async fixtures, and full pytest
Advisory, SBOM, license, and deprecation evidence
waves.rollback: Restore the prior Python runtime, exact approved lock, and environment image together; no schema change is reversed here.

waves.name: PostgreSQL service and runtime truth
waves.scope: Select and rehearse the approved regional PostgreSQL generation only after provider, data, cost, security, and recovery gates.
requiredTests: Full Alembic up and down graph
waves.rollback: Use the rehearsed restore or parallel prior supported major with an immutable backup and compatible application window.

waves.name: Browser quality toolchain
waves.scope: Lock Playwright, browser revisions, axe, Lighthouse, and the approved multi-browser/device matrix as a reproducible QA lane.
requiredTests: Chromium, Firefox, WebKit, Safari and iOS evidence
waves.rollback: Restore the prior proven runner, browser revisions, adapters, and reports while retaining required browser floors.

waves.name: Container, CI, cloud, and immutable delivery references
waves.scope: Select container images, CI actions, Azure API versions, observability, and provider adapters only after architecture, security, data, cost, and action gates.
requiredTests: Reproducible non-root image and immutable digest
Provider unavailable, quota, residency, retention, and deletion
Readiness, observability, backup, traffic rollback, and cost stops
waves.rollback: Retain the prior immutable release and compatible data, disable only the bounded adapter or workflow, and reverse traffic only after health and observability checks.
